description: Compile LaTeX source and optional auxiliary/binary files inside TeX402's hardened Docker TeX Live sandbox via POST /v1/compile ($0.008 USDC via x402). Automatically decodes and saves the binary PDF locally on this machine (avoiding huge base64 strings in context), includes a short-lived 15-minute HTTPS download_url when returned by the server, and optionally returns rendered 150-DPI PNG page previews as MCP image blocks.

bibliography.description: Run multi-pass BibTeX/Biber bibliography resolution when true (default false)

files.description: Optional map of relative project paths (e.g. 'refs.bib', 'style.sty', 'fig.png') to UTF-8 text or 'base64:...' payloads

files_from_disk.description: Optional map of target relative path in the TeX project -> local file path inside TEX402_ALLOWED_ROOT (or cwd) (auto-encodes .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.pdf/.eps/.ttf/.otf and binary files as base64:...)

include_page_previews.description: When true, renders 150-DPI PNG page previews and appends them as native MCP image/png content blocks for visual inspection

output_pdf_path.description: Local '.pdf' file path inside TEX402_ALLOWED_ROOT (or cwd) or os.tmpdir() where the compiled PDF should be saved (defaults to tex402-<timestamp>.pdf in os.tmpdir())

output_preview_dir.description: Optional local directory inside TEX402_ALLOWED_ROOT (or cwd) or os.tmpdir() where rendered PNG page previews (page-1.png, ...) should also be written on disk

return_base64.description: Include raw pdf_base64 in the JSON text response (default false to protect the LLM context window)

name: tex402_compile
title: TeX402 LaTeX to PDF Compiler ($0.008 USDC)
